status: REGISTERED before implementation and data collection
question: Does conditioning the policy on a learned summary of recent observation-action history improve wall-clock learning and adaptation under hidden dynamics variation, compared with the Cycle 1 four-frame stack?
hypothesis: Under per-episode vehicle randomization, an actor with a learned context z_t = f(o_{t-K:t}, a_{t-K:t-1}) reaches higher held-out distance at equal wall-clock budget than the four-frame stacked MLP, and retains more of that advantage on unseen vehicle/terrain shifts; a plain longer stack without the bottleneck is the control that separates history length from the encoder.

arms.A_stack4: Cycle 1 architecture: 4-frame stack of the 24-feature frame, MLP 64x64, no context module
arms.B_stack16: 16-frame stack, same MLP; controls for history length alone (actions are in the frame features)
arms.C_context: 4-frame stack plus a context encoder: MLP over the last 16 frames (observations and previous actions) producing z of dimension 8 that is concatenated to the stacked input; z is computed only from past observations available before the decision

training.hyperparameters: Cycle 1 defaults (rollout 128, minibatch 512, epochs 4, lr 3e-4, gamma 0.99, lambda 0.95, clip 0.2, entropy 0.01); identical across arms

measures: mean and median distance per condition
evaluation.statistics: per-arm means over the three training seeds with per-seed values reported; paired seed differences between arms; episode CIs reported separately and never as training-seed uncertainty

success_criteria: arm C beats arm A on the mean over three training seeds of held-out distance under randomization in at least four of six conditions with a positive paired difference in all three seeds; otherwise the context encoder is not adopted and the negative result is recorded
adaptation_follow_up: if C is adopted, the real-adaptation study compares context versus no-context on the new-vehicle and new-map conditions at equal exposure
exclusions: none after the fact; a run that fails to complete its budget is reported as failed and its seed is not replaced

cycle2_versions.observation_schema: surrogate-24-feature stack (A,B) / stack plus context (C); recorded per run
